You pull the handle and the little frame unfolds. Its shot tears a line through the press before the wheels snap back beneath your hands.

Rules

Action

Every creature in one straight line of three visible squares, each within 6 squares.
Equipment / acquisition
One reusable folding launcher (Bulk 1), built on learning and supplied if needed.
Type
Skill / Attack / Control

Unfold the launcher and make a Knowledge line attack.

Weak
4 physical damage; push 1 square away from you.
Standard
5 physical damage; push 2 squares away from you.
Strong
7 physical damage; push 3 squares away from you.

The launcher folds back into your hands after firing.
